experiment: P5n verified-idle-window shared frozen-forward and dense bounded-head execution
research_question: With the P5e five-model bounded-JNR candidate frozen, does one shared frozen base forward preserve complete full-pool outputs exactly and reduce guarded per-inference-batch latency relative to two frozen base forwards under a newly verified idle CUDA window?
single_changed_axis: P5n makes no model, feature, output, batch, timing or gate change relative to P5m. It changes only the quarantined P5m identities to fresh P5n identities and requires the known P3o-U CUDA task to have exited before P5n data execution begins.

authorized_environment.fallback_if_windows_driver_rejects_mode_: Proceed only if the P5h process guard is clean before launch, after analytic collection, before and after every timing call, and after execution. Record every mode-switch command and guard receipt.
authorized_environment.additional_launch_precondition: The P3o-U local-phase-dynamics CUDA process and every other external Python CUDA process must have exited before P5n starts. Do not start P5n while an external GPU experiment is active.

development_data.roles: evaluation-only; no training, selection, calibration or threshold adjustment
development_data.identity_rule: all five power views remain together; every new pool must have zero overlap with all locally retained historical train identities

execution.benchmark_batch: first complete index-ordered batch, indices 0 through 125, no data-dependent sampling
execution.reference: two frozen base forwards plus unchanged dense attachment
execution.candidate: one frozen base forward plus identical unchanged dense attachment
execution.timing: CUDA synchronize before and after every call.  Guard before/after full-pool equivalence and every warmup/repeat; reject any external Python PID whose nvidia-smi pmon type contains C.

stop_rule: Any external CUDA Python PID, exception, output non-equivalence or latency-gate failure freezes all P5n identities with no result claim and no implementation, head, feature, batch, scheduling, compiler or quantization change. Do not generate confirmation data unless every development gate passes.

confirmation_if_and_only_if_development_.decision: Only a confirmation pass supports the narrow output-equivalent frozen-execution per-batch cost claim. It never establishes a new architecture or classification claim.
